caption: The drawing features a single object placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object is a spindle-shaped candlestick holder with a dark gray or black body and several gold or yellow bands accentuating its horizontal contours. The holder has a circular base, broad and sturdy, narrowing and widening at various intervals along its height, creating a series of three main bulges before reaching the top. At the top, there is a flat circular platform with a sharp vertical spike in the middle. The entire object has a smooth texture with visible lines, and there is a small signature in the lower right corner of the image. There are no additional items or details present apart from the candlestick holder.
